name: electric_piano
description: Tine electric piano: a pitch-proportional FM body and a short inharmonic tine through an asymmetric pickup drive, with stereo tremolo.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch sets the FM body, the tine and the key-tracked low-pass; higher notes decay sooner. Per-note pitch bends all of them.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder notes bark through the pickup and open the filter. The tremolo pans the whole instrument: keep pan plus tremolo_depth within -1..1. The low-pass tracks six times the note frequency, so at full velocity notes from A7 up exceed its range.

name: bass
description: Finger bass: a sine and a saw body with a plucked-string attack, through a key-tracked low-pass that opens at each pluck.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch tunes the string, sine and saw; the low-pass tracks the key. The string's effective frequency must stay within 20-4000 Hz.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder notes open the filter further and damp the string less. The release mutes the string; growl sets the drive.

name: pad
description: Warm analog pad: four detuned saws in a stereo pair and a sub triangle, through a key-tracked resonant low-pass that drifts slowly.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch tunes every oscillator; the low-pass tracks three times the note frequency. Each key starts the drift at a different phase.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Velocity opens the filter; motion scales the drift. The voice is already stereo, so there is no pan control; set attack and release for swells.

name: kick
description: Sine with a curved pitch drop and a band-passed click, driven for weight.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder hits drop further and click louder. The release continues the decay after the gate.

name: snare
description: Two body modes with a small pitch drop and band-shaped noise wires; loud hits soft-clip.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder hits are brighter and carry more wire.

name: clap
description: Band-passed noise in a sharp burst, a second swell and a short tail.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder hits are brighter.

name: closed_hat
description: Six inharmonic square waves through a resonant band and a high-pass, with a short curved decay.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder hits are brighter. In the drums kit it chokes the open hat.

name: open_hat
description: The closed hat's metal with a longer curved decay.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder hits are brighter. Keep the release short so a closed hat can choke it in the kit.

name: low_tom
description: Two membrane modes, the second at 1.59 times the first, with a pitch drop.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder hits drop further. The release continues the decay after the gate.

name: high_tom
description: The low tom's membrane a fifth higher, with a shorter decay.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder hits drop further. The release continues the decay after the gate.

name: crash
description: The hat metal a fifth higher plus high-passed noise, with a long curved decay.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Velocity changes the sound as well as its level. Harder hits are brighter; the release lets it ring for over a second after the gate.

name: drums
description: The eight std/studio drums as one kit node, with the keys and gates of the std/basic/1.1.0 kit.
kit_notes: Write `hit` leaves with the keys kick, snare, clap, hat, open_hat, low_tom, high_tom and crash, and connect the kit's `out` once. Velocity changes each drum's sound. The closed hat cuts a ringing open hat. Set each drum with `<piece>_level`, `<piece>_pan` and `<piece>_brightness`; the defaults balance a boom-bap groove at -20 LUFS for velocity 0.7.
